data.title: Saudi Women’s Research at MIT Highlights Saudi Arabia’s Presence in Global Science
data.content:
Washington, November 20, 2026, SPA -- Saudi women are conducting advanced research at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) through the Ibn Khaldun Fellowship for Saudi Arabian Women. The fellowship goes beyond academic training, giving researchers the opportunity to build their expertise, exchange knowledge, and work as part of an international scientific community.
    The researchers’ experience at MIT builds on Saudi Arabia’s efforts to develop Saudi talent and broaden the participation of Saudi women researchers in international academic and research institutions. These efforts give them opportunities to work in advanced scientific settings and gain specialized experience that helps them advance their research careers.
    -- SPA
